features.title: One Effect service that runs the Jujutsu CLI
features.summary: Resolve jj once, run it with --color=never --no-pager, bounded stdout and stderr, a timeout and kill-on-interrupt; return a non-zero exit as a value or fail with redacted arguments and stderr.
failureModes: jj missing from PATH or resolved to a relative path fails with JjSpawnFailed and is retried on the next run instead of being cached.
A run over its timeout or interrupted by its caller has its process group killed.
A non-zero exit through exec carries flag-value-redacted arguments and credential-redacted stderr.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj CLI through the Effect ChildProcessSpawner with stdin ignored, bounded output, a timeout and process-group kill on interrupt.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary jj repositories created per test; no jj mock is used.

verification.testName: fails exec with JjCommandFailed carrying redacted args and stderr
stops a run that exceeds its timeout and kills the process
kills the process when the caller is interrupted

telemetry.testName: records one jj <verb> client span with value-free attributes and the exit code

features.title: Operation-head cache for jj view reads
features.summary: Answer repeated --ignore-working-copy view reads from the same operation head without spawning jj, share one in-flight read between callers, and miss as soon as an operation lands.
failureModes: A failed or non-zero read is not cached.
One caller's interruption leaves a shared read running for the other waiters; the last waiter's interruption stops it.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj CLI through the Effect ChildProcessSpawner with stdin ignored, bounded output, a timeout and process-group kill on interrupt.
